description: This file contains methods for generating a support packet in a Mattermost server, including collecting metadata, stats, job info, permissions, plugins, and database schema, with support for clustering and plugin hooks.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods to generate support packet data.

methods.name: GenerateSupportPacket
methods.description: Generates a support packet containing metadata, stats, jobs, permissions, plugins, and database schema, with support for clustering and plugin hooks.

methods.name: getSupportPacketStats
methods.description: Collects various statistics about users, channels, teams, commands, webhooks, and marshals into a YAML file.

methods.name: getSupportPacketJobList
methods.description: Collects recent job information of various types and marshals into a YAML file.

methods.name: getSupportPacketPermissionsInfo
methods.description: Gathers permission schemes and roles, marshals into a YAML file.

methods.name: getPluginsFile
methods.description: Retrieves installed plugins, formats as JSON, and returns as a file.

methods.name: getSupportPacketMetadata
methods.description: Generates and marshals support packet metadata into a YAML file.

methods.name: getSupportPacketDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Retrieves and marshals database schema info into a YAML file if using PostgreSQL.
